items.claim: CEO 說明營收口徑已從一年前的兩年 $20B 拉到本財年 $12B、下財年 $18B
items.quote: we can do $12 billion this year and $18 billion next year
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱資料中心營收從 2023 曆年約 $2.2B 到明年約 $15–16B
items.quote: next year, we're looking at $15 billion, $16 billion
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱連接業務今年成長 70% 以上，明年維持高成長但未給具體數字
items.quote: that business this year is growing like 70% plus
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 提到供應鏈一年內彈性上調約 50%
items.quote: our supply chain has been able to flex up 50%
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 回溯上一季對 NPO/CPO 明年營收的說法為 0 至 $300M
items.quote: we said it was going to be 0 to $300 million
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱上一季已說該數字會高得多
items.quote: This past quarter, I said that was going to be much higher
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CFO 給營業利益率路徑：本年底進入長期目標區間
items.quote: exit this year entering the long-term target model
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 稱明年底觸及該區間上緣
items.quote: We will exit next year touching the top end of that range.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 稱 Q3、Q4 營業利益率連續季增
items.quote: increase in operating margin in Q3 and again in Q4
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 稱客製化占比上升時毛利率會逐步下降
items.quote: you will see incremental step down
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CEO 說明客製化 NRE 以 contra R&D 入帳
items.quote: an offset or contra R&D
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱明年毛利率可在客製化翻倍下大致持平並伴隨營業利益率擴張
items.quote: gross margin flattish with OM expansion
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 拆解 $13.5B 到 $18B 的上調來源，多數來自互連、交換器與儲存
items.quote: most of that raise has come from interconnect and switching
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CFO 稱營運費用成長約為營收成長的一半
items.quote: your OpEx will grow roughly half the rate of revenue
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 承諾分析師日重設長期營業利益率目標
items.quote: we'll reset what we think the new long-term target is
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CEO 稱客製化 FY29 目標軌道正常，並預告分析師日將給區間
items.quote: we probably need to give a range for the future
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 預告 10/6 投資人日
items.quote: We got an Investor Day coming up on October 6.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱到目前為止拿到足夠供給以兌現承諾
items.quote: we're getting what we need, I think, to deliver
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱 Teralynx 交換器業務預計達 $1B 以上
items.quote: on track to do $1 billion plus
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱 scale-up 目前尚屬綠地市場
items.quote: sort of greenfield at the moment
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱 NPO 與 CPO 並存而非二選一
items.quote: this is not an or. This is going to be an and
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱 1.6T 的 2nm DSP 率先宣布
items.quote: We were first to market on announcing our 2-nanometer DSPs
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱 scale across 可能使 DCI 市場放大數倍
items.quote: that could 2, 3, 4, 5x the size of the DCI market
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱現有業務仍以每年 50% 以上成長
items.quote: the existing businesses growing at 50% a year plus
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱交換器加光學為下一個大型成長引擎
items.quote: switching plus optics is going to be very big
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱 1.6T 地位與以往同樣強
items.quote: we're as well positioned as we've ever been at 1.6T
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 預期多家公司將推出 XPU attach 策略
items.quote: a whole bunch of companies are going to come out
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱競爭對手多只有一塊拼圖
items.quote: A lot of our competitors don't have that.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱涵蓋四大美系雲端業者的設計案已逾 20 件
items.quote: 20-plus design wins across all the 4 U.S. hyperscalers
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 說明 Google 的 8-K 認股權屬 XPU attach 關係
items.quote: that is really an XPU attach relationship
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱客製化業務將多元而非單一插槽
items.quote: there's no one trick pony in there
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱與 NVIDIA 的關係是反向於緊張
items.quote: I would say it's the opposite of tension.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱供給自疫情以來持續吃緊
items.quote: It's been constrained since the pandemic.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱部分領域目前特別吃緊
items.quote: It's very acute right now in some areas.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 提到社會對資料中心的反彈
items.quote: societal pushback
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱若供給無限則產業總會過度擴張
items.quote: the industry always overdoes it
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CFO 稱資本配置第一支柱為讓公司成長
items.quote: pillar 1 of capital allocation is grow the company
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 稱保留彈性以供應鏈下單
items.quote: preserve the flexibility to put order in the supply chain
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CEO 稱已提高 CapEx 與預付款規模
items.quote: We've upped the CapEx and the prepays
items.speaker: CEO

qa_flags.question: Google 認股權協議的營收何時開始貢獻
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 先談歷史與 XPU attach 範疇，未給時點或金額，改指分析師日再說明

qa_flags.question: 對同業與金融夥伴合資建資料中心的風險看法
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO 表示不評論其他公司，回到技術領先與客戶成功；CEO 補充 Marvell 不參與

qa_flags.question: 客戶對土地、電力、廠房（LPS）的疑慮
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 稱沒有太多新資訊，轉談限制反而健康
